body.title: Resolve learner identity and verify adapter sources
body.summary: Implement approved identity resolver and local principal binding; document each GitHub/GitLab/Jira adapter's actual module, authenticated metadata source, stable-ID field and unavailable behavior. Reuse existing connections; no login flow or account inference from remote ownership.
acceptanceChecks: Single connected identity wins; multiple use repository Git email; no usable provider/Git identity falls back to OS
No automatic identity merge, case folding, agent/commit-author substitution or raw identity logging
Missing adapter is explicit; an available authenticated identity is discovered rather than silently ignored
Add and pass focused tests for this task before proceeding.
Source matrix names actual module/source/stable-ID field per provider, or evidence of missing integration; fixtures distinguish disconnected, unavailable lookup and missing adapter.

tests.name: Identity source precedence, authority separation and no automatic merge
Provider source matrix and available/disconnected/missing/failed adapters; Git/OS fallback
